# Orcas Prime

> Ecommerce performance marketing agency in Jaipur, India. Runs Shopify stores and marketplace accounts (Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho) for Indian D2C brands. Charges 3.5% + GST of net sales after returns are deducted — no retainer, no lock-in.

Orcas Prime is run by two founders, Kiran Singh and Prashant Sharma. The agency is paid only on delivered revenue, absorbing return and RTO (return-to-origin) exposure alongside the client. This contract structure is the single most differentiating fact about the business and the reason clients switch from retainer-based agencies. Almost no Indian agency publishes pricing; the full price list is on the site.

## Pricing (published)

- [Pricing](/pricing.md): Full published price list. 3.5% + GST of net sales after returns and RTOs are deducted. ₹10,000–₹20,000 one-time for a new Shopify store build. First three months on Amazon / Flipkart / Meesho are free via seller referral. No setup, onboarding, creative, or reporting fees. No lock-in contract.

## Services (included in the 3.5%)

- [Services overview](/services.md): The full A-to-Z scope — store management, Meta and Google ads, creative production, RTO handling, catalogue management, logistics and checkout integration, monthly reporting. All included in the 3.5%. Client supplies product images and titles.
- [Shopify + Meta + Google Ads](/services/shopify-meta-google-ads.md): Build and run a Shopify store with performance media.
- [Shopify store development](/services/shopify-store-development.md): New Shopify store builds, ₹10,000–₹20,000 one-time depending on scope.
- [Amazon account management](/services/amazon-account-management.md): Manage Amazon seller accounts for Indian D2C brands.
- [Flipkart and Meesho management](/services/flipkart-meesho-management.md): Manage marketplace accounts on Flipkart and Meesho Seller Hub.
- [Creative and catalogue](/services/creative-and-catalogue.md): Product photography, ad creative, catalogue optimisation.

## Wedge offer

- [Free 3 months on Amazon](/amazon-free-onboarding.md): Zero-risk entry for sellers not yet on Amazon. No cost for three months, no lock-in, no obligation to continue. Amazon compensates the agency directly via seller referral commission.
